Ensure proper weeding to eliminate alternative hosts of the virus e.g. volunteer potatoes, black nightshade and eggplant.
Plant early to avoid aphids which transmit the virus.
Encourage natural enemies of aphids such as lace wing, lady birds or parasitic wasps by growing a hedge around the farm.
Monitoring: Mild to severe leaf mottling and vein yellowing in severe cases.
Take action when 4-6 adults aphids are seen on the leaf.
Direct Control: Remove and destroy infected plants by burying (60cm deep) or burning.
Spray botanicals e.g. mixture of garlic, neem, red chilli pepper and soap.
Take 50g mixture in 2L water, boil for 15 minutes, allow to cool, then spray.
Place 1-4 yellow traps per 300m 2 to attract and kill the adult aphid.
